name: Harry and the Hendersons
description: The Hendersons, an upwardly mobile Seattle family, bring home what they believe to be a dead Bigfoot. But he has only been wounded by a hunter, and the Hendersons offer the creature who they come to call Harry a temporary home until a recovers his health.

videos.title: The Arrival
videos.overview: The Henderson family returning from vacation accidentally hits an eight foot Bigfoot and brings it home. They decide to nurse him, and end up letting him stay with them.

videos.title: The Day After
videos.overview: Harry's need for attention takes its toll on the Hendersons, especially George, who bigfoot-sits while preparing a work assignment.

videos.title: Cool
videos.overview: Harry feels uncomfortable in the Henderson home so he decides to run away.

videos.title: Harry Goes Home (1)
videos.overview: The family takes Harry back to the woods, only to discover that his home territory has been clearcut. Meanwhile, Ernie doesn't want Harry to go away. (Part 1 of 2)

videos.title: Whose Forest Is It Anyway? (2)
videos.overview: A local congressman's (Steve Landesberg) aid is sought when Harry's (Kevin Peter Hall) habitat is found destroyed. The clan petitions to save the forest. (Part 2 of 2)

videos.title: The Father-Son Game
videos.overview: George's and Ernie's attitudes differ over a father-son baseball game. George recruits Ken Griffey Jr. in a plan to spark Ernie's interest in baseball. Guest Stars: Ken Griffey Sr., Ken Griffey Jr.

videos.title: Baggin' the Big One
videos.overview: A British explorer, the son of a famous hunter, wants to outshine his father. In order to do that, he plans to bag Harry.

videos.title: Harry the Hero
videos.overview: The Hendersons try to close down an animal research lab by protesting after finding an escapee, a scruffy dog, on their doorstep.

videos.title: Roots, the Herb
videos.overview: Harry and an American Indian medicine man try to cure George's knee but he is reckless.

videos.title: The Mentor
videos.overview: The only doctor who can help a dying Harry is an elderly embittered anthropologist whose theories about Bigfoot were stamped out.

videos.title: The Bodyguard
videos.overview: A bully (Aeryk Egan) steals Ernie's special pair of sneakers needed by George for a presentation. Ernie uses Harry's formidable size and strength in a plan to retrieve them.

videos.title: Harry and the Homeless Man
videos.overview: Harry befriends a homeless intruder who reveals that he built the Hendersons' house. Meanwhile, the Hendersons are celebrating a birthday.

videos.title: Harry Goes Ape
videos.overview: A football legend visits the Hendersons' house along with his wife who is wearing a fur. Harry thinks that the fur is a dead person and decides to bury it.

videos.title: Pet Psychic
videos.overview: When Harry hides Nancy's diamond ring, the Hendersons ask a pet psychic (Michael Winslow) to read Harry's mind.

videos.title: The Bigfoot That Ate Seattle
videos.overview: A monster-movie director (Pat Morita) wants permission from the Hendersons to use Harry in one of his films.

videos.title: Harry and the Masked Wrestler
videos.overview: Harry becomes a wrestler to help Sarah raise money to save an injured sea lion. George asks wrestler 'Hacksaw' Jim Duggan to judge a benefit match featuring the debut of reluctant wrestler 'Bigfoot Man'.

videos.title: When Harry Met Sammy
videos.overview: When Tiffany brings Harry home, George and Nancy tell Samantha the truth, whetting her appetite for a good news story. Samantha decides to break the story of Harry on her news program.

videos.title: Harry and the Cheerleaders
videos.overview: When three Dallas Cowboy cheerleaders come to town on a mascot search, Ernie dreams that he loses his pal Harry to stardom. Ernie fears Harry may become the new mascot for the Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders.

videos.title: Retrospective
videos.overview: While the Hendersons prepare for Harry's first birthday party, they recall some of their memorable moments since his arrival.

videos.title: The Terror of the Trees
videos.overview: While on a camping trip with his son and his co-worker, George is nervous because his co-worker keeps on playing pranks and later mistakes Harry for a monster.

videos.title: Sarah Sings the Blues
videos.overview: Sarah is chosen to sing at the school dance with a new student but hesitates when she learns that he's blind.

videos.title: Mom
videos.overview: Nancy welcomes the arrival of her pregnant sister, Emily, unaware that another arrival is soon to follow.

videos.title: The Ransom of Bigfoot
videos.overview: Harry is home alone and left to the fate of two burglars who think a Bigfoot might draw a big reward.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: It's Halloween and Harry finally has a chance to get out. However, the Hendersons' neighbour, who is allergic to animal hair, becomes suspicious of Harry's "costume."

videos.title: Brett Hits Home
videos.overview: While George competes with an obnoxious co-worker for a promotion, Nancy's brother Brett moves in at home and is forced to contend with Harry.

videos.title: George's White Light
videos.overview: George examines his life after he's trapped in a steam room and, in a heat-induced delirium, sees God. He decides to quit his job.

videos.title: Working Stiffs
videos.overview: George's decision to quit his job and launch a magazine with Brett rockets the rest of the Hendersons into the job market.

videos.title: Love Mask
videos.overview: Brett thinks a primitive mask can cure his ailing love life by casting a spell on Darcy's Swedish au pair Uma, and it seems to work; but his date with her is spoiled by Harry, who is strangely obsessed with the mask as well.

videos.title: Blue Parrot
videos.overview: When Harry sets Ernie's pet parrot free, George and Nancy go shopping for a quick replacement.

videos.title: Winning
videos.overview: Angered at the foul attitude of Ernie's baseball coach, Nancy meets his challenge and strikes out on her own as a coach.

videos.title: Til Theft Do Us Part
videos.overview: The Hendersons suspect that all that glistens is not gold but their missing silver when Brett suddenly comes into a large sum of money.

videos.title: The Genius
videos.overview: Harry scores high on Ernie's IQ test, which changes the way everyone relates to Ernie especially when his teacher Ms. Hall comes to visit and encounters Harry.

videos.title: Wild Things
videos.overview: The Hendersons are shaken when Harry, fearing impending danger, traps them and a menagerie of forest friends inside their home.

videos.title: Fatherhood
videos.overview: In a case of mistaken identity, a baby is left on the doorstep with a note claiming that Brett is the father.

videos.title: Sara Spills the Bigfoot Beans
videos.overview: Sarah tells her boyfriend about Harry and jeopardizes the Hendersons' secret, and her love life, when she invites him to dinner.

videos.title: Moonlighting
videos.overview: Nancy moonlights as an aid to a foreign official and suspects his possession of a chimpanzee is on the dark side of the law.

videos.title: The Green-Eyed Bigfoot
videos.overview: Harry's friendship with Brett, and George's interview with a beautiful author, set off a wave of jealousy in the Henderson household.

videos.title: The Ichthyologist
videos.overview: George tries to help his cousin, who broke the law trying to save a polluted lake and its fish population.

videos.title: Selling Out
videos.overview: A businessman offers to buy George's magazine but the buyer's vision of yellow journalism makes George see red.

videos.title: The Girl Who Cried Bigfoot
videos.overview: Darcy discovers the Hendersons' secret and her parents, who doubt her story, send for a psychiatrist.

videos.title: The Busybody
videos.overview: A tabloid prints stories about a dangerous Bigfoot and turns the Hendersons' public life into a nightmare.

videos.title: I Got Your Birthday Right Here
videos.overview: Nancy takes a seat as vice principal at Sarah's school, which doesn't sit well with Sarah and Lorraine.

videos.title: Yo Richie!
videos.overview: Nancy's friend visits with her nephew, a boy who gives mischief a bad name.

videos.title: The Candidate
videos.overview: When George's friend is bullied from a political race, George finds a write-in candidate: a Bigfoot with a pristine past.

videos.title: The Bride and the Gloom
videos.overview: Darcy's scheme to have her Albanian housekeeper deported goes awry when the woman finds herself a husband: Brett.

videos.title: Born Again
videos.overview: The Hendersons plan a weekend of laid-back happenings for Nancy and Brett's visiting mother, only to find she would rather party.

videos.title: The Old Bigfoot
videos.overview: Harry brings home an old bigfoot, so the family consults Dr. Arnesen, who concludes he is preparing to die; Darcy introduces Brad to gorgeous Kate, but tells him she only likes brainy boys.

videos.title: The Outing
videos.overview: The media and an animal control officer discover Harry, so the family turn to sleazy talk show host Tony Lane for help.

videos.title: Harry Henderson National Treasure
videos.overview: With Harry's existence made public, the neighborhood is flooded with tourists, prompting angry residents to legally force Harry out.

videos.title: Breaking Up is Hard to Do
videos.overview: When George's cousin Melvin breaks up with his fiancee, he goes to the Hendersons for some advice and comfort.

videos.title: Blood Is Thicker Than...
videos.overview: Family ties unravel when George's brother visits and turns the Henderson home into a New Age shrine for Harry.

videos.title: Pitch, Pitch, Pitch
videos.overview: Nancy finds stardom when she's asked to be in a commercial. In her absence, the family finds out how much they need her.

videos.title: Harry the Mascot
videos.overview: Hoping to join the "cool" contingent at school, Ernie arranges for Harry to be school mascot for Madison Junior High.

videos.title: The Big Kiss Off
videos.overview: Everyone is skeptical when Brett's long-lost wife shows up after leaving him to pursue a movie career.

videos.title: The Frenchman
videos.overview: A French linguist studying Harry's speech speaks the language of romance to Sara and that translates into trouble.

videos.title: Laid Up
videos.overview: George and Harry become hospital roommates when Harry visits George and drops a television set on his foot.

videos.title: Harrywood Babylon
videos.overview: When Harry frightens shoppers, Brett sets out to change Harry's public image; but the documentary on Harry he produces demeans the family.

videos.title: Witness (1)
videos.overview: The Hendersons' lives are put in danger when Harry sees a philanthropist commit murder. (Part 1 of 2)

videos.title: Harry the Hostage (2)
videos.overview: Murder-witness Harry becomes a target; but Nancy devises a daring plan to stop the murderer. (Part 2 of 2)

videos.title: The Ex-Terminator
videos.overview: Nancy's fear of a mouse prompts George to hire an exterminator while Harry tries to protect his fellow creature.

videos.title: Beauty and the Beast
videos.overview: When Sara's stage production of "Beauty and the Beast" lacks an actor to play the Beast, George gets an idea and Harry becomes Sara's co-star.

videos.title: Big Feet, Small Minds
videos.overview: George is challenged by his church when he writes an article about Harry suggesting he is the missing link between apes and humans which leads to a boycott of "A Better Life."

videos.title: Surf's Down
videos.overview: George learns that shore waters are being polluted by a construction company owned by his friend and biggest advertiser.

videos.title: Follow Your Art
videos.overview: When Sara considers enrolling at an arts college 200 miles away, an overprotective George has trouble letting go.

videos.title: Them Bones
videos.overview: When George makes the "archaeological discovery of the century," he sees a chance to spend time with his dad, an amateur geologist with the emotions of a rock.

videos.title: The Three Facts of Brett
videos.overview: Ernie and Harry find a book of sorcery and cast a spell on Brett that makes him assume others' personalities.

videos.title: Ernie Confidential
videos.overview: Ernie explains his moussed hair and missed classes as follows: "I'm a man now. I've got my own trail to blaze." However, in the path of every pubescent pioneer is a protective mother.

videos.title: Uncle Mack Comes Back
videos.overview: George's Great-Uncle Mac from Scotland arrives to settle his affairs and die, which he does, but his ghost has some unsettled business.

videos.title: Skin Deep
videos.overview: Brett can't seem to choose between a witty waitress who wants a commitment and a more voluptuous cosmetician who doesn't demand commitment because, as Nancy says, "it has three syllables."

videos.title: Retrospective Three
videos.overview: A publisher rejects George's book about Harry. In a retrospective, we get another look at the past.

videos.title: The Long Goodbyes (1)
videos.overview: Tefta pines for Brett, who loves Mary. Meanwhile, Yetta, a female bigfoot from China, and Harry pine for one another but they need to avoid a customs agent. (Part 1 of 2)

videos.title: The Long Goodbyes (2)
videos.overview: In the series finale, the Henderson family decides to help Harry and his dear Yetta marry and move to a cave in the woods. Tefta pines for Brett, who loves Mary. (Part 2 of 2)
